name: permission-cycle-leaves-bypass-and-never-returns
description: When bypassPermissions was chosen in Settings, the first Cycle Permission Mode press moves to acceptEdits and the cycle never comes back to bypass. With no session running nothing is sent; the next launch carries the mode the cycle landed on.
reason: The cycle can lower the risk but never raise it to auto-approve-everything. A mode outside the cycle restarts it from its first entry, the safest editing mode.
source: DESIGN.md v1.7 'Safety invariants' 1; AppConfig.permissionModeCycle; AppState.nextValue(after:in:), AppState.cyclePermissionMode

script.reason: bypassPermissions is not in the cycle, so the cycle starts over at its first entry.
The last entry wraps to acceptEdits, never back to bypassPermissions.
No session was running, so the launch carries the mode on its command line.
